decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach with left arm, raising and orienting toward the mallet handle; right arm stays parked.
Advance above the left end of the mallet, gradually completing a downward grasp orientation aligned with its shaft.
Fine approach to the handle near its free end, lowering the open left gripper while matching the shaft direction.
Center the shaft between the left fingers using the wrist view, then close the gripper around the handle.
Keep the gripper fully closed and lift the mallet clear of its support; check visual retention before moving over keys.
Mallet appears retained. Raise further and turn its tip forward toward the first red key, keeping the left elbow-up posture.
Lower the retained mallet onto the leftmost red key, with a small lateral correction for perspective; check contact before lifting.
Center the tip on the red key and finish the downward tap, then lift more than 0.025 m before advancing right.
Move the lifted tip one key to the right, then tap the orange second key without sweeping across the keys.
Lift clear of the orange key by 0.054 m, advance right to the yellow third key, and strike vertically.
Finish the yellow tap, lift over 0.025 m, and advance to strike the green fourth key.
Lift after green, then angle the mallet toward the cyan fifth key while keeping the left hand in the left workspace and the right arm parked.
Center on the cyan fifth key, make the downward tap, and lift 0.054 m before the next key.
Maintain clearance while moving to the blue sixth key, then strike downward. Left hand remains on its own side.
Lift from the blue key and aim at the violet seventh key, using mallet yaw to extend the tip right without crossing the left arm.
Strike the violet seventh key vertically, then lift the mallet tip 0.054 m before moving to the last key.
Aim the lifted mallet at the rightmost magenta key using shaft rotation, keeping the left hand left of center and the right arm stationary.
Replan from the interrupted pose: the tip is over the final magenta key. Lower with a slight retreat for joint margin, strike, then lift 0.036 m.
